context: Omeluum is a neutral, friendly illithid scholar of the Society of Brilliance who only appears in this scene because the player previously rescued him from the Iron Throne; he’s a colleague and friend of Blurg, who will summon him when the illithid tadpole or related topics come up. He presents himself politely and is committed to improving life in the Underdark as part of the Society’s scientific efforts. Off-screen he has explained a past partnership with a lich that ended over conflicting goals, and now claims to feed only on those who act against the Society while experimenting with magic to curb his appetites. In this encounter he can answer questions (including about the tadpole) and has offered help or a reward if rescued, but if the player attacks him he will teleport away rather than fight.
